answer: Escrow here belongs to a lineage rather than to a seat. The bond demanded of every member equals the lineage's headcount times one base unit, so ten names from one lineage each hold ten units and the family locks a hundred in all, against one for a lone arrival on the mesa. A lineage mints a fresh ivory token in each epoch it stays solvent, and only emission its own members earned will season that token; gifted or purchased history mints nothing. Splitting into new lineages therefore buys an empty shelf, since the pulse of a real record cannot be copied into ten keys.
